limitations: A case is identified only when exactly the same 3–8 vessels occur in six or more consecutive 5-minute snapshots.
Observed span is (number of snapshot intervals - 1) * 5 minutes; actual physical duration needs raw AIS verification.
A group may appear in many snapshots; results are not independent events.
Daily bins counted here are only bins with candidates, not every bin with AIS.
Scatter plots use latitude/longitude without coastline or port basemap; not evidence of being offshore.
A CSV file part may cover sparse, noncontiguous dates, so daily comparisons are not comparable exposure estimates.
